lots.guide_summary: All surviving evidence is SOLD (11 PriceCharting tables of real completed eBay sales of loose PAL carts, pages opened); 0 unsold, 0 asking. Summed per title for the 10 visible carts: lower quartiles US$76.16 (AUD 110) to medians US$109.25 (AUD 157); adding a Banjo-Kazooie cart at its median (US$17.98, AUD 26) would lift the top to about AUD 183. Rate 1 USD = 1.4383 AUD (open.er-api.com, 1 Oct 2026). These are single-cart sales; a mixed bundle usually sells below the sum of parts.
lots.working: Keep: the lot is a bundle, so the 'lowest same-item SOLD price' is taken as the sum of each visible title's lower-quartile loose sale (not the absolute minimum, which is often a lot breakup or damaged cart): US$76.16 x 1.4383 = AUD 109.5; / 1.198 = 91.4, rounded down to $90 hammer ($107.82 all-in). Banjo-Kazooie excluded until a cart is confirmed. Flip: likely resale = sum of medians AUD 157.1, less eBay fees about 13% (AUD 20.4) and about AUD 15 outbound postage for a bundle = AUD 121.7; / 2.396 = 50.8, rounded down to $50 hammer. If Gowans confirms a genuine Banjo-Kazooie cart inside, keep rises to about (109.5 + 14.83 x 1.4383) / 1.198 = 121.7, so $120, and flip to about (183 x 0.87 - 15) / 2.396 = 60.2, so $60.
lots.confidence_reason: All ten cart labels read clearly in the photo and each has a 28 to 30 sale SOLD table I opened, but the carts are untested with label wear, the evidence is single-cart eBay sales worldwide rather than bundles, and the Banjo-Kazooie cart is unconfirmed.
lots.dropped_entries: All 7 researcher entries reclassified or dropped. The 5 PriceCharting 'loose price' guide figures (Banjo-Kazooie, Cruis'n USA, Kobe Bryant NBA Courtside, Extreme G, 1080 Snowboarding) are guide values, not prices paid; I re-opened the same URLs and replaced each with the page's own SOLD table (actual completed sales), so they now sit under SOLD with real dates. Hybrid Heaven dropped (not in the lot). Rush 2 entry dropped (the URL returned a strategy guide and Rush 2 is not in the lot). The researcher's AUD rate of 1.54 was wrong; the live rate is 1.4383. The researcher misread several titles: there is no Konami 'Track and Field' generic, Wipeout 64, Rush 2 or Extreme-G 2; the extra carts are Nagano Winter Olympics '98, Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey, Beetle Adventure Racing and Pilotwings 64.
lots.key_photo_findings: Read from the full-size photo: ten grey PAL carts with EUR/AUS NUS codes and 'Original Nintendo Seal of Quality' labels. Visible label wear and scuffing on most, Gex 64 and 1080 labels look the cleanest. Banjo-Kazooie is a pink plastic aftermarket-style case with a printed cover sheet (Rare logo, OFLC 'G' sticker image), not a cartridge; whether a cart is inside is not shown. The Kobe Bryant edition of NBA Courtside is confirmed by the label.
lots.condition: Loose carts, no boxes or manuals, label wear and grime, untested. Pins and saves not checked.
